reviews.title: So far so good
reviews.text: Budget class , value for money , average services, average food quality , less of leg space, no entertainment. Can be tried
reviews.author: Sumit Sharma

reviews.title: NEVER AGAIN
reviews.text: My elderly and sick mother accompanied by my sister came to Almaty airport earlier to be check up at 09 am, but the airplanes has been long gone at 04:00AM and there was no representative to explain the situation. When relatives approached the airline in Dushanbe after looking for hours whom to approach no one takes responsibility.
reviews.author: Zara Z

reviews.title: Amazing airline! I really liked it.
reviews.text: I am living now in Tajikistan as a tourist. I flew with this airline just once. What I liked - the flight was on-time. The seats were comfortable. I liked snacks. I found out that not so many people know about this airline. I think that more people should know about them. I would like to recommend this airline.
reviews.author: Agnetha F

reviews.title: Horrible management and airplane
reviews.text: This airline never on time. Very expensive ailine with very poor management and customer service The food is awful
reviews.author: Camila W

reviews.title: Nice, comfortable and on-time
reviews.text: 2020 is the worst year for everybody. I want to say that in summer we were in panic and did not know how to get home when the borders of all countries were unexpectedly closed. What a disaster! Thank God this airline of course with the participation of the governments arranged the repatriation flight and we got the chance to fly home. The prices for the flight were not expensive at all though we thought they would. It was a first surprise because we heard how all international carriers raised their prices to get the income as fast as they could. So, after 6 hours of a very comfortable and nice flight we were in Germany. The cabin was clean and the cabin crew were very friendly and English speaking. I want to thank a lady that served us. Such a beautiful and kind person! Thanks a lot Somon Air.
reviews.author: Valerie Curt

reviews.title: Passenger
reviews.text: This was a terrible disgusting airplane SOMON AIR I HAVE EVER SEEN AND flew with rude people dirty seats ..on the seats 💺 no push up buttons..stupid securities yelles at you..no respect at all...for breakfast they served us nasty sandwiches and cold water.are you serious
reviews.author: Malik Rah

reviews.title: Liked it very much!
reviews.text: Honestly to say, I expected not a good trip. But in fact I liked my flight with this airline. The crew was professional, speaking good English. Especially, I was impressed by ladies uniform. Such an exotic embroidery on jackets and skirts. One of ladies was very kind to talk with me and told that this uniform was ordered especially on the occasion of Tourism development year in their country. So, the rest was just fine. I liked the cabin and food. Wish a good luck to Somon Air.
reviews.author: Jerry Jones

reviews.title: the best idea is avoid from them
reviews.text: where do I begin. ground service was terrible because the check in staff did not understading english and If you are not speaking other than tajeek or russian she is speaking like scolding to you. the plane was wery old and uncomfortable. flight staff was inattentive. buying a ticket from them meaning that lkind a burning the money. never again. never suggest to anybody.
reviews.author: Joseph O

reviews.title: Not a bad airline
reviews.text: Definitely, the best airline in Tajikistan! It is not Emirates, of course. But deserves to fly with, for sure. We flew to Dubai with this airline. I really enjoyed that flight. The flight attendants were very friendly and attentive. The departure was on time. The food was not bad but I have to say it was not enough. :) I really liked the in-flight magazine. Wish a good luck to this airline.
reviews.author: Jinn F

reviews.title: Give it a try!
reviews.text: I was initially reluctant to fly on this carrier, but was pleased with the level of service I received. The check in was reasonably smooth and the boarding was without complications. We were given a dinner (in spite of the fact that the flight left in the morning!) and it was tasty. The flight was smooth enough to allow for about an hour of sleep, so the lack of any inflight entertainment was not a problem. The B737 was in decent shape and the cabin appeared clean and well cared for.
reviews.author: Ron R

reviews.title: Never Somon Air again!
reviews.text: WARNING! This is the crappiest airline among all. Pay a bit extra and fly with a more reputable and decent airline (Turkish Airlines, for instance). Somon Air treats you as garbage. I had a flight from Dushanbe to St. Petersburg with Somon Air, departure time 06:30, in the morning. I arrived at the airport more than two hours ahead, just to realise that my flight had been put off. The new departure time would be 16.5 hours later! Well, such things can happen, generally speaking. When it comes to Somon Air, these problems look more like a rule than an exception. Just a quick glance at board of departures tells the alarming truth: most flights are either cancelled or delayed. Their representatives at the airport helped me to reschedule my connecting flights from St. Petersburg. I will give them well deserved credit. The rest of this story is far from satisfying. Usually, stranded passengers will have access to a decent hotel room, while waiting. They brought me to a rundown Intourist Hotel where I got a dormitory bed. They gave me four US-dollars cash, to cover breakfast, lunch and dinner!! The money did not even cover my breakfast!! I succeeded in getting home, one day later. However, I lost one day of income and had some extra expenditures. At home I specified my claims to the airline. They just ignored my claims, with compact silence. This airline is a complete disaster. The services on board were also of inferior quality. For your own convenience and pleasure, please pay a bit extra and get the services you can expect. You get what you pay for.
reviews.author: Tommy P H R

reviews.title: Missing laggage
reviews.text: Arrived today from Dubai to Dushanbe on Somon Air and they have lost our laggage. We are here for 2 weeks holiday and we had everything for 3 of us in there and now don't know what to do. We have spoken to few people in Somon Air but no luck. No one is showing interest at all while we have no clothes,our medication or he necessary items.
reviews.author: Roukhchona H

reviews.title: Good and comfortable
reviews.text: I have been little bit scared by comments about Somon Air before flight, but actually, aircraft was in a good condition, sits are comfortable, no delay, careful personnel, big and tasty halal meal, toilets was clean. Online registration is unavailable, registration and laggage dropp-off at the airport organised in the eastern manner: there no organised line, people waiting in a mob, company representative selecting who can go to registration desk.
reviews.author: Sergey N

reviews.title: Great Airline
reviews.text: Excellent airline that cost the same as a LCC but actually have service and food for free onboard. The flight from dubai to dushanbe was on time both ways. Comfortable seats and declinable chairs.
reviews.author: JeLundgren

reviews.title: safe with Mr.Thomas W.Hallam II
reviews.text: Check-In at Almaty airport's Somon Air counter was very friendly and efficient. It all went very fast. Unfortunately afterwards one gets stuck at the most ridiculous passport exit control I have seen anywhere. I had to wait for about 50 minutes to get through and that was even before security. The flight itself was pleasant, the B737-800 with enough legroom and there was only Economy anyway on this 1h45min flight. Reading the inflight magazine it was comforting to see that the CEO of this airline is a former Delta Airlines Captain and that all pilots get regular training in the USA.
reviews.author: saronic

reviews.title: The flight left on scheduled time.
reviews.text: It was a pleasant flight, but strangely organised that we were served Food in the middle of the flight in stead of the time closing to arriving in Dushabne. Most of the other passengers were workers on their way back home from Russia. No Entertainment, but that is O.K. With a flight which lasts 5 hours from 1 a.m. in the morning. The flight was less than half full. All information was given in other Languages than English so we did not understand what was said.The flight was rather expensive. We got small pillows.
reviews.author: Ingeborg56

reviews.title: Bad organized
reviews.text: Very bad organized airlines, dedicated mainly for country officials and friends of crew. If you do not want to loose your psychic, do not use them. To be positive, they have quite new planes and food is acceptable.
reviews.author: Vladiape

reviews.title: A pleasant flight out of Dushanbe
reviews.text: Amazing take off out of Dushanbe with snow-covered mountains on each side. Very good service, friendly smartly dressed staff, clean plane and good movies for the short distance. A very good airline to develop Tajikistan's tourism industry.
reviews.author: Catherine E

reviews.title: Alright in a vacuum of litte option
reviews.text: Bare bones flight with forgettable service and terrible food by the lowest standards. Unfortunately there are almost no other options from Dushanbe, so Somon Air it will be in the future I suppose...
